english: Powered Melee Hits summon <arc Jolting /> lightning strikes in a 15 meter radius around the struck enemy, each dealing <pve 181 /> <pvp [50] /> <arc Arc /> damage.

source.text:
Upon scoring a Powered Melee Hit: 
Enemies within 15 meters of the struck enemy are hit by lightning.
Lightning deals 181 [50] Arc Damage and inflicts Jolt.
